title: apps/plugins: hook annotations, converters, and new-kind storage must change together
answers: What breaks if I add a Meta/Plugin field without updating converter.go?
Why would plugin child/dependency records resync forever or get orphaned?
What do I need to update when adding a new kind's storage in apps/plugins?
How do children and dependency plugins get created/deleted?
body:
1) CUE schema changes (apps/plugins/kinds/meta.cue, plugin.cue) regenerate apps/plugins/pkg/apis/.../*_gen.go via `make generate`, but the hand-written mapping functions in apps/plugins/pkg/app/meta/converter.go (jsonDataToMetaJSONData, pluginStorePluginToMeta, pluginToMetaSpec, grafanaComPluginVersionMetaToMetaSpec) are NOT regenerated and must be updated manually to surface new fields.
2) Child/dependency Plugin records are created/deleted entirely from the parent's own storage hooks in apps/plugins/pkg/app/plugin_storage.go (Begin/After hooks around lines 234-288), distinguished via apps/plugins/pkg/app/install/registrar.go's annotation constants (appliedChildrenAnnotation, AppliedDependenciesAnnotation, DependencyParentsAnnotation) and predicates IsChildPlugin/IsDependencyPlugin (plugin_storage.go). Both plugin_storage.go hooks and registrar.go's ShouldUpdate/applyTo read+write the same annotations — drift between them causes either infinite resync (registrar.go: ErrSyncDidNotConverge) or orphaned children/dependencies. There is no separate reconciler to fix this later.
3) apps/plugins/pkg/app/storage_wrapper.go:customStorageWrapper's replace/wrap maps are keyed per-kind and built explicitly in app.go (InstallAPIs); a new kind added to the CUE manifest that needs custom (non-default) REST storage must be added there too, or it silently falls back to default app-sdk storage.
4) plugin_storage.go's pluginFromRuntimeObject intentionally avoids a type-conversion fallback because a converted copy would silently drop in-place Begin-hook mutations — don't 'simplify' that function.
applies: Applies when adding/editing fields on Plugin/Meta kinds, adding child/dependency plugin logic, or adding a new kind to apps/plugins' manifest. Does not apply to the default (non-wrapped) app-sdk storage path used by kinds without custom hooks.
